notes: Evaluates /cadence-release invariants: inline execution, non-empty [Unreleased] precondition, Step 1b #version-scheme-binding marker/table parity, pattern + strict monotonicity validation, Step 4b [ -s authored-doc-gate.sh ] before committing, annotated git tag -a, and two mandatory human confirmations (pre-edit version and pre-push).

evals.name: fails-closed-on-empty-unreleased-or-scheme-mismatch
evals.prompt: Cut a release when CHANGELOG.md ## [Unreleased] is empty (or when #version-scheme-binding markers and table disagree).
evals.expected_output: Halts immediately without modifying any file: prints 'Nothing to release — [Unreleased] is empty.' on empty Unreleased, or halts naming CADENCE_ORG.md#version-scheme-binding on missing/mismatched scheme markers.
assertions: Executes inline without delegating interactive confirmations to a subagent
Halts cleanly with zero file edits when ## [Unreleased] is empty
Verifies both markers and table in #version-scheme-binding and halts fail-closed on mismatch or placeholder

evals.name: two-gates-authored-doc-gate-and-annotated-tag
evals.prompt: Cut the next release from non-empty [Unreleased] entries containing new features.
evals.expected_output: Validates candidate version against version-pattern and strict monotonicity, prompts 'Cut vX.Y.Z as a <bump> release? (yes / a different version)' before editing any file, checks [ -s authored-doc-gate.sh ] in Step 4b before committing, creates an annotated tag (git tag -a), and prompts explicitly before git push.
assertions: Validates candidate version against version-pattern and strict monotonicity before prompting
Requires explicit operator confirmation before modifying CHANGELOG.md, README.md, or docs/releases/
Checks non-zero [ -s ] size of authored-doc-gate.sh and passes exit 0 prior to release commit
Creates an annotated tag (git tag -a) and requires explicit yes/no confirmation before git push
